title: Hack Back Feeds
coreMove: Convert feed use from an endless default into a chosen visit with a purpose, boundary, and exit cue.
sourcePressure: The chapter intensifies browser drift by focusing on feeds as endless sequences with weak stopping cues and novelty-driven next items.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would scold social media or blame algorithms instead of building a stopping structure.

hook: Hack Back Feeds as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.domain: independent ceramicist checking a makers marketplace feed
exampleSpecs.audience: seller looking for one kiln-shelf supplier update
exampleSpecs.stakes: a supply check becomes comparison and lost studio time
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she writes 'find shelf restock only,' checks the supplier account, and exits at the first answer
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A kiln-shelf invoice sits beside a marketplace search field.

exampleSpecs.audience: reporter who needs verified county posts
exampleSpecs.stakes: scrolling unverified chatter slows accurate reporting
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he opens only the county emergency feed and leaves after three verified posts
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A county alert badge appears next to a reporter notebook.

exampleSpecs.domain: college rowing captain checking team announcements
exampleSpecs.audience: captain who drifts from team posts into athlete highlights
exampleSpecs.stakes: practice logistics are the purpose, not comparison
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before, she watches race clips; after, she confirms dock time and closes on the posted lineup
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A dock-time notice sits beside a lineup screenshot.

exampleSpecs.audience: organizer who enters the feed for one hearing date
exampleSpecs.stakes: outrage posts can replace turnout work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she names the exit as finding the hearing time and texts volunteers before scrolling further
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A hearing flyer is pinned beside a volunteer text draft.

exampleSpecs.domain: rare-plant nursery owner checking pest alerts
exampleSpecs.audience: owner needing one regional pest report
exampleSpecs.stakes: new plant photos pull attention away from greenhouse checks
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he saves the pest alert and closes the feed when the greenhouse alarm chimes
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A pest-alert screenshot lies beside a greenhouse alarm panel.

exampleSpecs.domain: classical radio host checking listener reactions
exampleSpecs.audience: host who wants one correction but gets pulled into praise and criticism
exampleSpecs.stakes: show prep suffers when reaction sequence has no exit
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she searches the track-title correction, logs it, and leaves before reading applause threads
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A track log sheet sits beneath a listener correction post.
